_doc: Brokenspire (docs/brokenspire.txt): its people and its quests. pipeline/unreal/882 writes them into the town's generator (FRDTownsfolkDef, FRDQuestDef). A person: role (ERDTownRole), title (their name), calling (what they are), the model (pack and mesh under /Game/<pack>/; clips: the pack's own Demoscene idle and in-place walk unless named), scale, count (how many of the role's posts it may take), lines (said when she speaks to them; the first is their greeting) and topics (question|answer, the ones with functionality). A quest: giver (Elder, Scholar, Captain, Board), goal (a counter: see FRDQuestDef), count, gold, reward item, after (offered once that one is done), hint (the tracker's line).

townsfolk.name: Aldric
townsfolk.title: Aldric Venn
lines: Thank the old wardens: an arm that isn't shaking. Sit, stranger. Brokenspire has need of you.
topics: Why do you need my help?|Three moons ago the spire on the castle hill cracked in two in a single night. Since then the mist has crept down from Mistward Castle, and things walk in it. Our watch is farmers with spears; the captain has buried eleven of them. We need someone who can go in, not only hold a gate.

What is Mistward Castle?|The wardens' keep. For three hundred years they kept the Mistward sealed beneath it. The last of them went down into the deep halls when the spire broke, and none came back. Now its gate breathes mist and its halls are full of what the mist brings.

What happened to the town?|Look around you. Half the houses are boarded up; others burned when the first things came over the wall. The refugees from the farms sleep by the gate. We pray, we drink, we wait. Waiting is all we are good at, it seems.

townsfolk.name: Corvin
townsfolk.title: Corvin the Masked
lines: You found me. Sit, and keep your voice down: the drunk by the hearth hears more than you would think.
topics: What is the Mistward?|Not a mist. A breath. Something beneath the castle breathes, slowly, as a sleeper does, and the wardens' seal was the hand over its mouth. When the spire broke, the hand slipped.

Who broke the spire?|Not lightning. I have looked at the stones: they fell outward, from inside, as if something pushed. Someone in the deep halls wanted the seal open. I mean to learn who, and you are going where I cannot.

What should I look for down there?|Tiers. The castle goes down in tiers, each older than the last, each sealed by the wardens. As you open them the mist thickens and its creatures harden. Every tier you open tells me something. Bring me news from the third.

townsfolk.name: Hale
townsfolk.title: Captain Hale Brannock
lines: Stay out of my soldiers' way and we'll get along. Or do you want work? I have work.
topics: What lies beyond the gate?|Farms, once. Now the mist sits in the hollows and things hunt the roads. The gate stays barred until I have the men to hold the road beyond it. Not yet.
How many soldiers do you have?|Nineteen, counting the militia on the walls. Twelve of them can hold a spear properly. We lost eleven on the castle road before we learned to stay off it.

townsfolk.name: Brom
townsfolk.title: Brom Hollowhand
lines: Mind the sparks. What do you need mended?
Your blade's chipped. Bring it here; I'll not charge you for looking.
My boy wanted to join the watch. I made him a shield instead. Thicker than mine.
Anvil's free if you know your way round one.

townsfolk.name: Silas
townsfolk.title: Silas Quell
lines: Everything has a price, friend. Especially now.
Potions, fresh this morning. Well, this week.
Find anything shiny in that castle, you know where to sell it. Fair prices. Mostly.

townsfolk.name: Maelis
townsfolk.title: Sister Maelis
lines: Sit if you're bleeding. Stand if you're not. I've no chairs left.
I haven't slept since the spire fell. Please don't make me stitch you.
Drink this. No, it doesn't taste better the second time.

townsfolk.name: Odran
townsfolk.title: Father Odran
lines: The light still listens, here. Kneel if you would be blessed.
Every candle on that altar is someone the mist took. I light a new one every morning.

townsfolk.name: Wenna
townsfolk.title: Wenna Thatch
lines: Leave what you like, I'll mind it. I mind everything in here.
Your chest's at the back. Nobody touches it but you.

townsfolk.name: Gorric
townsfolk.title: Gorric
lines: The ale's thin and the stew's thinner, but the fire's real.
That one in the mask has been sitting there since the night the spire broke. Pays in silver, never smiles.
No rooms, sorry. The refugees have them.

townsfolk.name: Pell
townsfolk.title: Old Pell
lines: The spire... the spire went *crack*. Like that. *Crack.* I was there. Mostly.
Buy me one and I'll tell you where the wardens hid their silver. ...I don't know where. Buy me one anyway.
Don't drink the well water after dark. Tastes of mist.

townsfolk.name: Hagra
townsfolk.title: Mother Hagra
lines: Ahh. The mist likes you. I can smell it on your boots.
They call me a witch and then they come to my door at night for the fever-tea. Go on, ask what you came to ask.
Something down there is dreaming, girl. Don't wake it all at once.

townsfolk.name: Child1
townsfolk.title: Little Wren
lines: Are you going to the castle? Will you bring me back a monster tooth?
Mother says I mustn't go near the gate.

townsfolk.name: Child2
townsfolk.title: Tobin
lines: I'm a warden! Hyah! ...You can be the monster.
My da's in the watch. He has a real spear.

townsfolk.name: Child3
townsfolk.title: Pip
lines: The masked man in the tavern gave me a copper for being quiet.
Did you see the mist come down the hill? It looks like breath.

townsfolk.name: Refugee1
townsfolk.title: a refugee
lines: We left everything at Harrowfield. The cattle, the barn. My mother's grave.
They say the gate will open again when the captain has men. They said that last month.

townsfolk.name: Refugee2
townsfolk.title: a refugee
lines: Bread? No? Then move along, please. I'm tired of being looked at.
The things in the mist don't bleed right. I put a pitchfork in one.

townsfolk.name: Refugee3
townsfolk.title: a refugee
lines: My husband went back for the goats. That was nine days ago.
Is it true you'll go into the castle? Then the gods go with you.

townsfolk.name: Tam
townsfolk.title: Simple Tam
lines: I counted the towers. Eleven! No, twelve. No... I'll count again.
The spire broke because it was tired. I get tired too.
Do you want to see my stone? It's a good stone.

townsfolk.name: Kelm
townsfolk.title: Brother Kelm
lines: Repent! The breath beneath the hill will take us all, and it will not be quick!
The wardens failed. The spire failed. And you, stranger, you will fail too.
Mark me: when the last candle gutters on that altar, the mist will come for the children.

townsfolk.name: Ashe
townsfolk.title: Widow Ashe
lines: He was nineteen. He went up the castle road with the watch and they brought back his spear.
I come every day. Someone should.

townsfolk.name: Guard1
townsfolk.title: a guard
lines: Move along. The gate's barred, captain's orders.
Nothing gets through this gate. Nothing gets out, either.

townsfolk.name: Guard2
townsfolk.title: a guard
lines: The castle hall's full of them. We just keep them from coming down the hill.
If you're going in, go in. Don't stand in the door.

townsfolk.name: Guard3
townsfolk.title: a guard
lines: Watch yourself in there.
Hear that? That's the hall. Things moving.

townsfolk.name: Militia1
townsfolk.title: a militiaman
lines: Quiet night. They're always quiet, until they aren't.
I was a cooper, before. Now I walk walls.

townsfolk.name: Militia2
townsfolk.title: a militiawoman
lines: Saw lights out past the mill last night. Green ones.
Captain says two more weeks and we'll have enough to open the gate. Captain says a lot.

townsfolk.name: Soldier1
townsfolk.title: a soldier
lines: Off duty. Go bother the captain.
Eleven bunks empty in here. Don't ask.

townsfolk.name: Soldier2
townsfolk.title: a soldier
lines: My sword's sharp. My boots are not. Story of this town.
You going down the castle? Kill one for Garrick.

townsfolk.name: Townsman1
townsfolk.title: a townsman
lines: Fine day. Well. A day.
Don't mind the boards on the windows. Helps us sleep.

townsfolk.name: Townsman2
townsfolk.title: a townsman
lines: My brother's house burned the first night. He lives with us now. All eleven of them.
You're the one going into the castle? Huh. Thought you'd be taller.

townsfolk.name: Townsman3
townsfolk.title: a townsman
lines: The trader charges double since the spire fell. Triple for you, probably.
Good luck. Really.

townsfolk.name: Townswoman1
townsfolk.title: a townswoman
lines: I hang a bundle of rue on the door every night. Mother Hagra says it keeps the mist out.
Have you seen my sister's boy? Tobin? Always running off.

townsfolk.name: Townswoman2
townsfolk.title: a townswoman
lines: We bake twice a week now. Flour's running out.
The temple bell used to ring at dawn. Father Odran says it'll ring again.

quests.title: Word from the Spire
quests.offer: There is a stranger at the tavern, a scholar of some kind, who came the night the spire broke. He knows more than he says. Speak with him, and come back and tell me what you learn.
quests.done: So he spoke to you. A breath under the hill, a seal pushed open from below... I had hoped it was only a storm. Here: it is little, but it is honest coin.
quests.hint: Talk to the scholar in the tavern

quests.title: The Mistward Hall
quests.offer: The castle's great hall stands open, and the things that came out of the mist lie in it. The way down lies through that hall: through the old Mistgate at its back. Clear the hall, at least the worst of them, and show the town it can be done.
quests.done: They saw you come down the hill with the creatures' blood on you. You should have heard the tavern. Take this; Sister Maelis made it for whoever went first.
quests.hint: Kill five of the Mistward Hall's guards (the castle, through its door)

quests.title: Into the Mist
quests.offer: The Mistgate at the back of the hall: walk through it. The wardens built it as their door into the deep halls. Go down, look around, and come back alive. That is all I ask, this time.
quests.done: You came back. You do not know what that means to them out there. Go and see the scholar; and the captain has work for someone who can come back.
quests.hint: Walk through the Mistgate into Mistward Castle

quests.title: The Third Seal
quests.offer: Open the castle's third tier. Its seal is the oldest I can still read about. Come back and tell me what the air smells of down there.
quests.done: Ash and iron. Then it is older than the wardens... Take this for your trouble, and keep going down.
quests.hint: Open the third tier of Mistward Castle

quests.title: Wardens' Bones
quests.offer: The strongest things in each tier... I think they were wardens, once, before the breath took them. Put two of them to rest and I will know whether the seal can be closed again.
quests.done: Wardens, then. I am sorry. But now we know what we are fighting, and what it wants.
quests.hint: Slay two of the castle's tier bosses

quests.title: Thin the Horde
quests.offer: Every one of those things you kill in the castle is one that won't come down the hill. Fifteen, and I'll pay as if you were one of mine.
quests.done: Fifteen. Good. That's more than my whole watch managed in a month.

quests.title: Cells Under the Keep
quests.offer: Some of my scouts were taken alive: dragged into the castle and caged. If you find cells down there, open them.
quests.done: Two of them walked in at dawn, white as ghosts, asking for their mothers. Thank you.
quests.hint: Free two prisoners from the castle's cells

quests.title: The First Warden
quests.offer: Each time a tier opens down there, something big comes up to meet whoever opened it. Kill one of those.
quests.done: You killed one of the big ones. Take this ring; it was my father's. He'd want it used.
quests.hint: Slay a tier's boss in Mistward Castle

quests.title: Wolves on the Mill Road
quests.offer: Something has been killing the sheep along the mill road beyond the wall. When the gate opens, I want it dead.
quests.hint: The wilderness: when the gate opens

quests.title: The Lost Patrol
quests.offer: Five of mine went out to the old watchtower before the gate was barred. Find them, or what's left of them.
quests.hint: The wilderness: when the gate opens

quests.title: Rats in the Cellars
quests.offer: BOUNTY. The castle's rats have grown big enough to carry off a dog. Six tails, thirty coins. (signed: the miller)
quests.hint: Kill six rats in Mistward Castle

quests.title: The Drinkers
quests.offer: BOUNTY. Things that look like men and drink like leeches. Four of them, thirty-five coins. (the watch)
quests.hint: Kill four Drinkers in Mistward Castle

quests.title: Dead Soldiers Walking
quests.offer: BOUNTY. The dead of the castle road walk in the castle's halls. Put four to rest. Forty coins. (Father Odran)
quests.done: Father Odran pays, and blesses the coins.
quests.hint: Kill four dead soldiers in Mistward Castle

quests.title: The Plague Medics
quests.offer: BOUNTY. Masked things that carry saws. Three of them. Thirty coins. (Sister Maelis)
quests.hint: Kill three Medics in Mistward Castle

quests.title: Crawling Things
quests.offer: BOUNTY. The crawling things in the lower halls. Four. Thirty-five coins. (Brom the smith: they ate his apprentice's boots)
quests.done: Brom pays, and laughs for the first time in weeks.
quests.hint: Kill four crawling Sliders in Mistward Castle

quests.title: Fowl Play
quests.offer: BOUNTY. Yes, chickens. From the castle. With teeth. Three of them, twenty coins. (Gorric, the tavern)
quests.done: Gorric pays, and asks if they're edible.
